summary.name: Tincta
summary.one_liner: Tincta is a one-window text editor for macOS with syntax highlighting for many languages, which is no longer on the Mac App Store and is now open source.
use_cases: Writing blog posts or drafting emails on a Mac
Editing source code or web design files
Find and replace text using regular expressions
Converting line endings or text encodings
Building an open source macOS app from source
summary.what_it_does: Tincta is a single-window text editor for macOS aimed at both casual writing and programming. It offers syntax coloring for over 65 languages, search and replace with RegEx support, line numbering, and full Unicode support. It includes multiple built-in color themes and supports custom themes. Smaller features include auto close brackets, auto indent, a page guide, line wrapping, drag and drop, tab indentation of selections, case changing, invisible character display, encoding and line ending conversion, tab/space conversion, a spell checker, printing, and block selection.
notable: Native app for Intel and Apple Silicon Macs
Open source; repository available to build yourself
Removed from Mac App Store after incompatibility with macOS Ventura
caveats: No longer available in the Mac App Store and not compatible with macOS Ventura
Building from source is suggested for Monterey or older systems
